headline: Executive order renames Lake Ontario as "Lake America" and honors the history of the Great Lakes.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order renames Lake Ontario, one of the five Great Lakes, as "Lake America." It also states that it honors the American history of the Great Lakes. No summary was provided, so details such as which agencies must use the new name, or how maps and official documents would change, are not available.
when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the available material; the order was signed August 27, 2026.
